title: Tutto è come il lasciai
subtitle: The Count and the Countess: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 2
note: The Countess confesses that Cherubino is in the closet
about: Score: the recitative “Tutto è come il lasciai” before the Act 2 Finale (vocal score pages 138-140, 29 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
